gloss: tipping feature; donation function (on a live-streaming or social media platform)

definitions.gloss: tipping feature; donation function (on a live-streaming platform)
definitions.explanation: An online feature that allows viewers to send money to a streamer, creator, or performer in real time while watching or reading their content. Common on live-streaming sites, video platforms, and social media, where it serves as direct viewer-to-creator financial support.

examples.japanese: {投|な}げ{銭|せん}{機能|きのう}を{使|つか}う。
このサービスには{投|な}げ{銭|せん}{機能|きのう}がある。
examples.english: This service has a tipping feature.

examples.japanese: {配信者|はいしんしゃ}は{投|な}げ{銭|せん}{機能|きのう}で{収入|しゅうにゅう}を{得|え}ている。
examples.english: Streamers earn income through the tipping feature.

examples.japanese: {最近|さいきん}の{動画|どうが}プラットフォームでは、{投|な}げ{銭|せん}{機能|きのう}を{導入|どうにゅう}することで{クリエイター}を{支援|しえん}する{仕組|しく}みが{整|ととの}いつつある。
examples.english: Recent video platforms are putting in place systems to support creators by introducing tipping features.

notes:
Composed of {投|な}げ{銭|せん} (tossing a coin; tip, historically a coin tossed to street performers) and {機能|きのう} (function; feature). The original {投|な}げ{銭|せん} referred to coins thrown to traveling musicians and street performers; the modern digital usage extends this image to online platforms.

USAGE:
A 21st-century tech term. You will see it on service-description pages, news articles about streamers, and in conversations about YouTube, Twitch, niconico, and similar platforms. The {機能|きのう} part can be dropped when context is clear — people often just say {投|な}げ{銭|せん}をもらう (to receive a tip). On English-language platforms, the feature often has brand names like "Super Chat," "Bits," or "Tips," which in Japanese are grouped under {投|な}げ{銭|せん}{機能|きのう}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {投|な}げ{銭|せん}{機能|きのう}を{使|つか}う: to use the tipping feature
- {投|な}げ{銭|せん}{機能|きのう}を{導入|どうにゅう}する: to introduce a tipping feature
- {投|な}げ{銭|せん}を{送|おく}る: to send a tip
- {投|な}げ{銭|せん}で{応援|おうえん}する: to support (a creator) with tips

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {投|な}げ{銭|せん}: tip; money tossed to a performer — the base noun, used alone or as a verb with する
- {チップ}: tip (foreign-style gratuity) — used for tipping in restaurants and services rather than online content
- {スーパーチャット}: Super Chat — a specific implementation of {投|な}げ{銭|せん}{機能|きのう} on YouTube Live
- {課金|かきん}: paid usage; in-app purchases — broader concept covering any payment to a service
